panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
VAs on engine V8 or later, customers using 3 or more target features (proposed), the VA with the most conversations still below V8, and the target feature fewest customers use. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_latest, n360.v_feature_use, n360.v_va_change  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest configuration read; the last 30 days

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT argMax(c.va, c.convs_30) FROM n360.v_va_change AS c
              INNER JOIN n360.v_va_config_latest AS g ON g.bot_id = c.bot_id WHERE NOT g.current_engine AND c.account IN (${account:singlequote})) AS busiest,
             (SELECT argMin(feature, n) FROM (SELECT feature, countIf(used) AS n FROM n360.v_feature_use
                                               WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY feature HAVING countIf(used IS NOT NULL) > 0)) AS least
        SELECT if((SELECT count() FROM n360.v_va_config_latest) = 0, NULL, concat(
                   toString(countIf(current_engine)), ' of ', concat(toString(count()), if(count() = 1, ' VA', ' VAs')), ' on V8 or later · ',
                   toString((SELECT countIf(n >= (SELECT target_features_min FROM n360.settings)) FROM
                             (SELECT account, countIf(used) AS n FROM n360.v_feature_use WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY account))),
                   ' customers use 3+ target features',
                   if(busiest = '', '', concat(' · busiest VA still to upgrade: ', busiest)),
                   if(least = '', '', concat(' · least-used feature: ', least)))) AS sentence
        FROM n360.v_va_config_latest WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: VAs on V8 or later
panels.description:
VAs whose weekly configuration read shows V8 or later; change against the read 30 days earlier. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.va_config_snapshot  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** weekly reads, the last 30 days

targets.rawSql:
WITH nightly AS (SELECT snapshot_date AS night, toUInt64(countIf(engine_major >= (SELECT engine_current_major FROM n360.settings))) AS value
        FROM n360.va_config_snapshot WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY night),
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly) AS newest,
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly WHERE night <= newest - 30) AS ref_30,
             (SELECT min(night) FROM nightly) AS oldest,
             if(ref_30 IS NULL OR ref_30 = toDate(0), if(oldest < newest, oldest, NULL), ref_30) AS ref,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = newest) AS v_now,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = ref) AS v_then
        SELECT toDateTime(night) AS time, value, if(ref IS NULL, 'no earlier night stored', concat(multiIf(v_now > v_then, concat('+', toString(v_now - v_then)), v_now < v_then, concat('−', toString(v_then - v_now)), 'no change'), ' since ', toString(toDayOfMonth(ref)), ' ', formatDateTime(ref, '%b'))) AS change
        FROM nightly WHERE night > newest - 30 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Customers using 3+ target features
panels.description:
Customers that used at least 3 of the 5 target features in the last 30 days (proposed list). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_feature_use  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(countIf(n_read > 0) = 0, NULL, countIf(n_used >= (SELECT target_features_min FROM n360.settings))) AS `of the 5 target features`
        FROM (SELECT account, countIf(used) AS n_used, countIf(used IS NOT NULL) AS n_read FROM n360.v_feature_use
              WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY account)

panels.title: Legacy intents on VAs below V8
panels.description:
Legacy intents still configured on VAs older than V8: the upgrade backlog. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_latest  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read per VA

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sumIf(legacy_intents, NOT current_engine)) AS `to move to playbooks`
        FROM n360.v_va_config_latest WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: VAs containing under 50%
panels.description:
VAs whose containment (1 - handoffs / engaged, per VA) over the last 30 days is under 50% (proposed, n360.settings containment_low_pct). VAs without handoff data are not counted.

**Source:** n360.v_va_change  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(containment_30 < (SELECT containment_low_pct FROM n360.settings)) AS `of VAs with handoff data`
        FROM n360.v_va_change WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Engine by customer
panels.description:
Each customer's VAs by engine, as a share (V8 or later green, older amber: the v1.1 page's colours), sorted by V8 share. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_latest  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read per VA

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, countIf(c.current_engine) AS `V8 or later`, countIf(NOT c.current_engine) AS Older
        FROM n360.v_va_config_latest AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY Customer ORDER BY countIf(c.current_engine) / count() DESC, Customer

panels.title: Customers using each target feature
panels.description:
How many customers used each target feature in the last 30 days (proposed list; Testing, Calibration and Recipes are not exported yet). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_feature_use  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT feature AS Feature, countIf(used) AS Customers FROM n360.v_feature_use WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})
        GROUP BY feature HAVING countIf(used IS NOT NULL) > 0 ORDER BY Customers DESC

panels.title: Coverage and adoption by customer
panels.description:
Per customer: VAs on V8 or later, and each target feature used (green) or not (light grey) in the last 30 days; "Not reported yet" where the source has no rows for the customer. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_feature_use, n360.v_va_config_latest  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer,
               any(g.v8) AS `VAs on V8+`,
               anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'V8 playbooks') AS `V8 playbooks`,
               anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'Authoring tool') AS `Authoring tool`,
               anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'Analytics assistant') AS `Analytics assistant`,
               anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'MCP servers') AS `MCP servers`,
               anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'Supervisory rules') AS `Supervisory rules`, a.account AS account
        FROM n360.account AS a INNER JOIN n360.v_feature_use AS f ON f.account = a.account
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT account, toNullable(concat(toString(countIf(current_engine)), ' of ', toString(count()))) AS v8
                   FROM n360.v_va_config_latest GROUP BY account) AS g ON g.account = a.account
        WHERE a.account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY a.display_name, a.account ORDER BY Customer

panels.title: Upgrade queue: VAs below V8, busiest first
panels.description:
VAs still on an engine older than V8, ranked by conversations in the last 30 days: the first row is the one to upgrade next (most traffic moves). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_va_change, n360.v_va_config_latest  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read; the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.va AS VA, a.display_name AS Customer, g.engine_version AS Engine, g.legacy_intents AS `Legacy intents`,
               g.v8_playbooks AS `V8 playbooks`, c.convs_30 AS `Conversations, 30 days`,
               concat('/d/n360-va?var-account=', c.account, '&var-va=', toString(c.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.v_va_change AS c INNER JOIN n360.v_va_config_latest AS g ON g.bot_id = c.bot_id
        INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND NOT g.current_engine ORDER BY `Conversations, 30 days` DESC

defaults.noValue: Every VA is on V8 or later

panels.title: Containment by channel
panels.description:
Containment per VA, grouped by channel (never one number across channels), last 30 days against the 30 before; the change is in points (▼ down, ▲ up). VAs without handoff data are on the Containment dashboard.

**Source:** n360.v_va_change  
**Filter:** Customer; VAs with handoff data  
**Window:** the 60 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.channel AS Channel, c.va AS VA, a.display_name AS Customer, c.containment_30 AS `Last 30 days`,
               c.containment_prev_30 AS `30 before`,
               multiIf(c.containment_change_pts IS NULL, NULL, c.containment_change_pts >= 1, concat('▲ ', toString(c.containment_change_pts)),
                       c.containment_change_pts <= -1, concat('▼ ', toString(abs(c.containment_change_pts))), '● steady') AS Change,
               concat('/d/n360-va?var-account=', c.account, '&var-va=', toString(c.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.v_va_change AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND c.containment_30 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Channel, `Last 30 days`

panels.title: Idle playbooks: built, not run in 31 days
panels.description:
Playbooks that exist (they have daily rows) but ran 0 times in the 31 days to the data-through day (v1.1 "Authored, not live"). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.playbook_day  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pb.playbook AS Playbook, concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, ac.display_name AS Customer,
               concat('/d/n360-va?var-account=', pb.account, '&var-va=', toString(pb.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.playbook_day AS pb INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = pb.bot_id
        INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = pb.account
        WHERE pb.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND pb.day > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 31
        GROUP BY pb.playbook, pb.account, pb.bot_id, v.va_name, v.channels, ac.display_name HAVING sum(pb.executions) = 0
        ORDER BY Customer

panels.title: Configuration changes since the last read
panels.description:
What changed per VA between its two newest weekly reads. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_change  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the two newest reads per VA

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, ac.display_name AS Customer, concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(ch.snapshot_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(ch.snapshot_date, '%b %Y')) AS `Read on`,
               arrayStringConcat(ch.changes, '; ') AS Changes
        FROM n360.v_va_config_change AS ch INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = ch.bot_id
        INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = ch.account
        WHERE ch.account IN (${account:singlequote})

defaults.noValue: No changes since the last read

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: no change since the last read

panels.title: Authoring sessions and assistant questions, customer users
panels.description:
Per complete week, sessions in the authoring tool and questions to the analytics assistant by customer users only (staff left out). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.cortex_day, n360.explorer_day  
**Filter:** Customer; customer users  
**Window:** dashboard time range, complete weeks

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toMonday(c.day)) AS time, sum(c.authoring_sessions) AS `Authoring sessions`,
               sum(e.questions) AS `Analytics-assistant questions`
        FROM n360.cortex_day AS c INNER JOIN n360.explorer_day AS e
             ON e.account = c.account AND e.day = c.day AND e.user_type = c.user_type
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND c.user_type = 'customer' AND $__dateFilter(c.day)
          AND toMonday(c.day) >= toDate($__fromTime) AND toMonday(c.day) + 6 <= (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded')
        GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
